newsitem.title: USA: Fingerhut names catalog business executive.
newsitem.headline: Fingerhut names catalog business executive.

text.p: Fingerhut Cos Inc said Tuesday it named Peter Michielutti, senior vice president and chief financial officer, as executive vice president and chief operating officer for Fingerhut's catalog business, effective immediately.
A replacement for Michielutti will be named shortly.
Michielutti, 40, will be responsible for all operating aspects of the catalog marketing business. He will report directly to Ted Deikel, Fingerhut chairman.

Michielutti's post is a new one at Fingerhut. Rakesh Kaul was chief operating officer and vice chairman of the entire company before leaving Fingerhut last year to join Hanover Direct Inc, a Fingerhut spokeswoman said.
